description.en: Light spills from the brightest points into the dark around them, with the warm edge film gives it.
description.zh-CN: 最亮的地方把光漏进周围的暗处，边上带一点胶片的暖晕。

description.en: A lens that splits light at its edges: colours part towards the corners, the centre stays sharp.
description.zh-CN: 在边缘把光拆开的镜头：越靠近角落颜色越分离，中心保持清晰。

description.en: A big bass drum, a timpani hit and cymbal swells: weight on the cuts.
description.zh-CN: 大鼓、定音鼓与吊镲渐强：给切点加分量。

description.en: A double bass plucked: round low notes that walk under the music.
description.zh-CN: 拨弦的低音提琴：圆厚的低音，在音乐底下走。

sources.name: Versilian Studios Chamber Orchestra 2, Community Edition

description.en: A picture on a glass tube: scan lines, phosphor stripes, a gently curved face.
description.zh-CN: 显像管上的画面：扫描线、荧光条纹、微微鼓起的屏。

description.en: Bands of the picture slip sideways: something has shifted, and holds there.
description.zh-CN: 画面的横条向旁边错开：有什么东西移了位，停在那里。

description.en: The two pictures melt into each other, gently at both ends.
description.zh-CN: 两个画面慢慢融进彼此，首尾都很轻。

description.en: A one-bit picture: two colours, and a pattern of pixels doing the work of every grey.
description.zh-CN: 一位色的画面：只有两种颜色，灰度全靠像素的排列。

description.en: The whole picture in two inks: one for the darks, one for the lights.
description.zh-CN: 整幅画面只用两种颜色：一种给暗部，一种给亮部。

description.en: The outlines of what matters light up, like a rim of light behind a subject, glowing out into the dark.
description.zh-CN: 主体的轮廓亮起来，像身后打来的一圈轮廓光，向暗处慢慢晕开。

description.en: Seen through reeded glass: the picture breaks into upright ribs of light, its shapes kept, its detail hidden.
description.zh-CN: 隔着条纹玻璃看：画面碎成一根根竖直的光条，形还在，细节藏了起来。

description.en: A glockenspiel: tiny bright bells that sparkle on top.
description.zh-CN: 钟琴：小小的、明亮的铃声，在最上面闪光。

description.en: A picture you can almost touch: fine grain that lives from frame to frame.
description.zh-CN: 画面摸起来有颗粒：细细的颗粒，每一帧都在动。

description.en: A picture pulled through a printer's screen: ink dots on paper, bold enough to read as print.
description.zh-CN: 画面过了一遍印刷网屏：纸上的油墨网点，粗到一眼看出是印出来的。

description.en: A concert harp: bright plucked notes that ring and shimmer.
description.zh-CN: 音乐会竖琴：明亮的拨弦，余音闪闪发光。

description.en: A short bright riser, noise opening upward over a thin climbing tone (1.00 s; the cut at its end, 1.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 短而亮的上升：噪声往上打开，下面一层细的音往上爬（1.00 秒；切点在结尾，1.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A riser of noise and a climbing synth chord, an octave and a half (2.00 s; the cut at its end, 2.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 噪声加一组往上爬一个半八度的合成器和弦（2.00 秒；切点在结尾，2.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A riser of noise alone, opening from dark to bright (2.00 s; the cut at its end, 2.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 只有噪声的上升，从暗打开到亮（2.00 秒；切点在结尾，2.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A long riser with a strong climbing synth chord, two octaves (3.00 s; the cut at its end, 3.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 较长的上升，合成器和弦往上爬两个八度，音调感强（3.00 秒；切点在结尾，3.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A long, slow riser from very low, noise and a deep chord climbing two octaves (4.00 s; the cut at its end, 4.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 很长很慢的上升，从很低处起，噪声与低沉的和弦往上爬两个八度（4.00 秒；切点在结尾，4.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A long riser carried by its chord more than its noise, one octave (4.00 s; the cut at its end, 4.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 很长的上升，主要是和弦（一个八度），噪声在后（4.00 秒；切点在结尾，4.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A long, high, airy riser, thin noise and a high tone climbing far (3.00 s; the cut at its end, 3.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 较长、偏高偏亮的上升，细的噪声与一个高音爬得很远（3.00 秒；切点在结尾，3.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A short riser led by a low chord, one octave (1.50 s; the cut at its end, 1.500 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 短的上升，以低和弦为主，一个八度（1.50 秒；切点在结尾，1.500 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A two-colour print run: two inks laid one over the other, a little out of register, on uncoated paper.
description.zh-CN: 双色孔版印刷：两种油墨叠印，略微错位，印在不涂布的纸上。

description.en: Violins, violas and cellos holding long notes, soft and swelling.
description.zh-CN: 小提琴、中提琴、大提琴拉长音，柔和、会慢慢涨起来。

sources.name: Versilian Studios Chamber Orchestra 2, Community Edition

description.en: Violins and cellos bouncing short notes: a pulse that drives forward.
description.zh-CN: 小提琴与大提琴的短促跳弓：往前推的律动。

sources.name: Versilian Studios Chamber Orchestra 2, Community Edition

description.en: A long sub drop from 90 to 28 Hz with a firm click on its front (2.00 s; the cut at its start, 0.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 较长的低音从 90 Hz 落到 28 Hz，前面一下清楚的咔嗒（2.00 秒；切点在开头，0.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A very long, gritty sub drop from 80 to 25 Hz (3.00 s; the cut at its start, 0.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 很长、带颗粒的低音，从 80 Hz 落到 25 Hz（3.00 秒；切点在开头，0.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A short, punchy drop from 160 to 50 Hz with a sharp click (0.60 s; the cut at its start, 0.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 短促有力的下落，从 160 Hz 到 50 Hz，前面一下脆的咔嗒（0.60 秒；切点在开头，0.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A smooth sub drop from 140 to 35 Hz, no click (2.00 s; the cut at its start, 0.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 平滑的低音下落，从 140 Hz 到 35 Hz，没有咔嗒（2.00 秒；切点在开头，0.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A heavily driven low drop from 70 to 30 Hz (1.20 s; the cut at its start, 0.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.
description.zh-CN: 失真重的低音下落，从 70 Hz 到 30 Hz（1.20 秒；切点在开头，0.000 秒）。Émile 合成。

description.en: A long, driven sub drop from 110 to 30 Hz with a click (2.50 s; the cut at its start, 0.000 s). Synthesised by Émile.

skills.name: choosing-filters
skills.title: Choosing a filter
skills.description: Which of Émile's free filters fits a moment of the film, how long it holds up there, and the pictures it fails on, all fifteen in one page. Use it before laying a filter over a film or when the person names a feeling rather than a filter; not for transitions.

skills.name: motion
skills.title: How things move
skills.description: How things in a film should move, as judgement and not a catalogue. What carries the motion, where the one accent falls, fast next to still, which words are large, and when to leave the frame alone. Read when planning a film and when writing a clip.

skills.name: scoring
skills.title: Scoring a film
skills.description: How to give a film its music in Émile: when to write a score on the instrument packs and when to generate music from a prompt, how to choose a tempo the cuts land on, how to shape the music to the film's sections, voice it so it sounds good, leave room for a voice-over, and the mistakes that make film music sound cheap. Read it before write_score or generate_music.

skills.name: sound-ambience-crossfade
skills.title: Ambience crossfade: never a hole
skills.description: Crossing two places' sound beds over a dissolve or a soft cut so the film never drops into silence: lengths, curves, and filling a gap with a bed. Read when a dissolve joins two shots with sound, or a cut leaves a hole in the sound.

skills.name: sound-j-cut
skills.title: J-cut: hear it before you see it
skills.description: A J-cut, the next shot's sound heard before its picture (audio lead, pre-lap): what it is for, how far ahead, and how to do it on Émile's timeline and with ffmpeg. Read when a cut goes into a new place that has a sound of its own.

skills.name: sound-l-cut
skills.title: L-cut: let it ring on
skills.description: An L-cut, a shot's sound carried on into the next picture (audio tail, post-lap): what it is for, how long, and how to do it on Émile's timeline and with ffmpeg. Read when a moment's sound should linger past its cut.

skills.name: sound-match-cut
skills.title: Sound match cut: one sound becomes another
skills.description: A sound match cut, one sound turning into another across a cut (a helicopter's blades into a ceiling fan, a keyboard's tap into a raindrop) so two shots are joined by what we hear. When it works, how to find one, and how to time it. Read when two shots share a motion, a rhythm or a shape.

skills.name: sound-music-handoff
skills.title: Music handoff: change on the downbeat, end on a hit
skills.description: Changing or ending the film's music at a cut: on a downbeat, from one section or track to the next, stopping dead for effect, and ending on a hit instead of a fade. Read when the music has to change at a scene change, and for every film's end.

skills.name: sound-riser-hit
skills.title: Riser into a hit: build, breathe, land
skills.description: The turn of a film made to land: a riser or a swell building into the cut, a breath of near-silence just before it, then a hit and a sub-drop on it with the music re-entering. Timings, sounds, levels, and how to do it. Read for the reveal, the product's first appearance, the title, the drop.

skills.name: sound-transitions
skills.title: Sound across a cut
skills.description: How a film's sound carries it across a cut or a transition, and which of the seven ways suits each one (J-cut, L-cut, ambience crossfade, whoosh, riser into a hit, sound match cut, music handoff). Read before laying any sound on a cut, and when the person asks for transitions "with sound", "more cinematic" or "like an ad".

skills.name: sound-whoosh
skills.title: Whoosh: the sound of the move
skills.description: A whoosh on a moving transition (push, wipe, zoom, whip pan, something flying across the frame): which length, where its peak goes, how loud, and when to leave it out. Read before laying a whoosh or a sweep.

skills.name: subtitle-box-word
skills.title: Box word subtitles
skills.description: White capitals; the word being said is wiped onto a red box from the left.

skills.name: subtitle-candy
skills.title: Candy subtitles
skills.description: Chunky rounded words with a thick dark outline, each its own colour in turn, bouncing in one after another as they are said.

skills.name: subtitle-classic
skills.title: Classic subtitles
skills.description: White words in a dark glass box, a chunk at a time.

skills.name: subtitle-clean
skills.title: Clean subtitles
skills.description: Plain white words on a soft shadow, a chunk at a time.

skills.name: subtitle-confetti
skills.title: Confetti subtitles
skills.description: The whole line at once in heavy rounded capitals, each word its own colour in turn, the words bobbing gently.

skills.name: subtitle-decode
skills.title: Decode subtitles
skills.description: Monospace words that arrive as scrambled characters and resolve, letter by letter, as they are said.

skills.name: subtitle-editorial
skills.title: Editorial subtitles
skills.description: Two faces: plain light words, and the keywords set large in an italic serif, like a magazine pull quote.

skills.name: subtitle-giant
skills.title: Giant subtitles
skills.description: One word at a time as large as the frame takes it, a red serif with a fine dark outline; the words fill the safe area, not the subtitle band.

skills.name: subtitle-glitch
skills.title: Glitch subtitles
skills.description: Heavy capitals that tear into red and cyan as each line arrives, then settle with a faint split.

skills.name: subtitle-headline
skills.title: Headline subtitles
skills.description: The keywords set large in a red display serif on a line of their own, the rest of the sentence small beneath in a light serif, each word lit as it is said.

skills.name: subtitle-highlight
skills.title: Highlight subtitles
skills.description: Heavy capitals, a chunk at a time, the word being said lit in lime and a touch bigger. The default subtitle style.

skills.name: subtitle-karaoke-pill
skills.title: Karaoke pill subtitles
skills.description: The chunk on a cream pill, its words filling from grey to ink as they are said, the one being said in coral.

skills.name: subtitle-layers
skills.title: Layers subtitles
skills.description: One huge serif word at a time in red, two coloured copies behind it drifting apart at different speeds, so the word stands in depth.

skills.name: subtitle-neon
skills.title: Neon subtitles
skills.description: Spaced capitals in dim teal; the word being said and the keywords light up as neon, flickering on.

skills.name: subtitle-pill
skills.title: Pill subtitles
skills.description: Bold words with the one being said on a violet rounded block.

skills.name: subtitle-pop
skills.title: Pop subtitles
skills.description: One big word at a time, popping in with a little overshoot.

skills.name: subtitle-reveal
skills.title: Reveal subtitles
skills.description: Words light up as they are said; the rest of the chunk waits dimmed.

skills.name: subtitle-rise
skills.title: Rise subtitles
skills.description: Clean sentence case; each word rises into place as it is said, the rest of the chunk waiting unseen.

skills.name: subtitle-serif-reveal
skills.title: Serif reveal subtitles
skills.description: A display serif, each word fading up out of a soft blur as it is said.

skills.name: subtitle-slam
skills.title: Slam subtitles
skills.description: One word at a time, huge condensed capitals that slide in from the left out of a blur; keywords in yellow.

skills.name: subtitle-stack
skills.title: Stack subtitles
skills.description: A few words at a time stacked one to a line in huge condensed capitals that fill the frame, the keyword in yellow.

skills.name: subtitle-sticker
skills.title: Sticker subtitles
skills.description: One word at a time on a tilted yellow sticker that slaps into place.

skills.name: subtitle-typewriter
skills.title: Typewriter subtitles
skills.description: Monospace words typed letter by letter as they are said, a block caret at the end.

skills.name: subtitle-weight-shift
skills.title: Weight shift subtitles
skills.description: Light words that turn bold as they are said, the weight swelling smoothly.

skills.name: subtitle-word
skills.title: Word subtitles
skills.description: Strictly one word on screen at a time, big and clean. Only for languages that space their words.
